description: This file manages environment variable configurations for Matrix authentication, including resolving scoped and global configs, checking readiness, and providing hints and messages for setup.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims a string value or returns an empty string if not a string.

methods.name: resolveGlobalMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves environment variables into a MatrixEnvConfig object for global scope.

methods.name: resolveScopedMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves environment variables into a MatrixEnvConfig object for a specific account scope.

methods.name: hasReadyMatrixEnvAuth
methods.description: Checks if the given MatrixEnvConfig has sufficient info to be considered ready for authentication.

methods.name: resolveMatrixEnvAuthReadiness
methods.description: Determines if the environment is ready for Matrix authentication for a given account, providing hints and messages.
